item.title: NFL teams are becoming more willing to trade two first-round picks for elite defensive players
item.description: Defense wins championships. That’s why NFL teams are becoming more willing to part with valuable draft picks for elite defenders. Trading two first-rounders for a player has been rare with fewer than 20 such deals over the past 40 years.
